# mergeset

> Find which branches/PRs can be merged together: maximal conflict-free, test-passing subsets of changes.

- [mergeset.tiers](_autosummary/mergeset.tiers.html.md): Tiered validation: a cheap oracle screens, an expensive one confirms.
- [mergeset.validation](_autosummary/mergeset.validation.html.md): Validation functions: does this merged tree actually work?
